vectors.name: forgery-reconcile-plain-in-coalition: a reconcile target in a coalition that carries its secrets readable, as a group’s does, is ignored, so no coalition log ever keeps one
forgery-reconcile-sealed-and-plain: a sealed target that also carries a secret is a bad shape, and ignored
forgery-reconcile-sealed-short: a sealed field that isn’t one 1,024-byte blob is a bad shape, and ignored
forgery-reconcile-own-seat: a reconcile target whose key is one of this coalition’s own seats is ignored, so a member group can’t act for the coalition above
forgery-reconcile-dispatch: a coalition’s reconcile motion carrying a Dispatch is ignored, as an admit carrying one is (#124)
forgery-reconcile-non-participant: a reconcile target from someone who hasn’t joined the coalition is ignored
forgery-reconcile-repeat-key: a second reconcile target with a seat key an earlier one here holds is ignored, so each seat above is one motion’s
forgery-reconcile-forming: a reconcile target before the coalition has formed is ignored
forgery-reconcile-sealed-in-group: a group’s log ignores a sealed reconcile target: a group has no inner to seal under, and carries its own reconcile target plain
